title.zh: “锑”旧焕新：可再生锑光热化学储热项目
title.en: Antimony Renewal: Renewable Antimony Solar-Thermochemical Storage

summary.zh: 围绕锑尾矿与冶金渣资源化，团队利用湿法冶金回收锑资源，并开发适配的热化学储热吸热器与智能调控系统；本人承担副主持、三维建模与赛事表达工作。
summary.en: The team recovered antimony from tailings and metallurgical slag through hydrometallurgy and developed a thermochemical-storage receiver with intelligent control; the user served as deputy lead and handled 3D modeling and competition communication.
summary.chinese-traditional: 圍繞銻尾礦與冶金渣資源化，團隊利用溼法冶金回收銻資源，並開發適配的熱化學儲熱吸熱器與智能調控系統；本人承擔副主持、三維建模與賽事表達工作。

Other members led the core method and experiments; this work did not replace methodological contributions, but it was a clear and indispensable indirect contribution that enabled the project to form, keep iterating, and ultimately become a paper.

actions.zh: 组织培训 17 所大学宣讲队伍。

actions.zh: 完成中南大学本科招生宣讲目标。
actions.en: Completed CSU undergraduate admissions outreach goals.
actions.chinese-traditional: 完成中南大學本科招生宣講目標。

outcomes.zh: 在中南大学获评优秀并认定 2 学分。

outcomes.chinese-traditional: 在中南大學獲評優秀並認定 2 學分。

outcomes.zh: 次年相关录取率同比增长 288%。
outcomes.en: The following year's related admission rate increased 288% year over year.
outcomes.chinese-traditional: 次年相關錄取率同比增長 288%。

context.en: The outreach aimed to increase CSU’s visibility at the user’s former high school and bring together alumni studying at different universities.

context.en: The task was to deliver the joint presentation and meet CSU undergraduate-admissions outreach goals.

summary.zh: 连续参与三届百公里毅行，从普通志愿者成长为校区负责人，形成招募、传播和现场协同的量化记录。
summary.en: Participated in three editions of the 100 km walk, progressing from volunteer to campus lead with measurable recruitment and outreach results.
summary.chinese-traditional: 連續參與三屆百公里毅行，從普通志願者成長為校區負責人，形成招募、傳播和現場協同的量化記錄。

actions.zh: 累计招募志愿者 31 人次、线上拉新 467 人次。
actions.en: Recruited 31 volunteer participations and 467 online participants.
actions.chinese-traditional: 累計招募志願者 31 人次、線上拉新 467 人次。

actions.zh: 完成广告投放 322 次、发放奖品 240 个。
actions.en: Completed 322 promotional placements and distributed 240 prizes.

outcomes.zh: 两次获评省级优秀志愿者。

outcomes.chinese-traditional: 兩次獲評省級優秀志願者。

context.en: The event was organized by the Hunan Provincial Communist Youth League, Hunan Sports Bureau, and Hunan Daily.
context.chinese-traditional: 活動由共青團湖南省委、湖南省體育局和湖南日報社主辦。

title.zh: 小问号 weekend：从课题组成员到优秀组长
title.en: Question Mark Weekend: From Team Member to Outstanding Lead
title.chinese-traditional: 小問號 weekend：從課題組成員到優秀組長

role.zh: 科学课题组成员 → 组长
role.chinese-traditional: 科學課題組成員 → 組長

summary.zh: 基于 2024 春季科学课题组经历选择留任并竞选秋季组长，完整负责招募、培训、课程包组织、交付与结项。
summary.en: After serving in the spring 2024 science group, stayed on and became autumn lead, taking responsibility for recruitment, training, lesson-package organization, delivery, and closure.
summary.chinese-traditional: 基於 2024 春季科學課題組經歷選擇留任並競選秋季組長，完整負責招募、培訓、課程包組織、交付與結項。

actions.zh: 制作保底大纲，全权组织新成员初筛和面试。
actions.en: Prepared a fallback outline and fully organized initial screening and interviews for new members.
actions.chinese-traditional: 製作保底大綱，全權組織新成員初篩和麵試。

actions.zh: 10 月 13 日组织专题课培训会。
actions.en: Organized the topic-course training meeting on October 13.
actions.chinese-traditional: 10 月 13 日組織專題課培訓會。

actions.zh: 带领 4 名组员按 1V1 模式组织工作。
actions.en: Led four members through a one-to-one responsibility model.
actions.chinese-traditional: 帶領 4 名組員按 1V1 模式組織工作。

actions.zh: 10 月 22 日交付《惊喜一跳——水杯对乒乓球的帮助》。
actions.en: Delivered “A Surprising Jump — How a Cup Helps a Ping-pong Ball” on October 22.
actions.chinese-traditional: 10 月 22 日交付《驚喜一跳——水杯對乒乓球的幫助》。

actions.zh: 10 月 29 日交付《温水沸腾——气压的秘密》。
actions.en: Delivered “Warm Water Boiling — The Secret of Air Pressure” on October 29.
actions.chinese-traditional: 10 月 29 日交付《溫水沸騰——氣壓的秘密》。

actions.zh: 11 月 5 日交付《魔术谜底——点水成冰》。
actions.en: Delivered “The Secret Behind the Magic — Freezing Water at a Touch” on November 5.
actions.chinese-traditional: 11 月 5 日交付《魔術謎底——點水成冰》。

actions.zh: 11 月 12 日交付《冻住的流水——层流现象》。
actions.en: Delivered “Frozen Flow — Laminar Flow” on November 12.
actions.chinese-traditional: 11 月 12 日交付《凍住的流水——層流現象》。

actions.zh: 四套课程包均提前一个工作日按质交付；11 月 14 日组织优秀志愿者评选并完成项目收尾。
actions.en: All four lesson packages were delivered to standard one working day early; organized volunteer recognition and project closure on November 14.
actions.chinese-traditional: 四套課程包均提前一個工作日按質交付；11 月 14 日組織優秀志願者評選並完成項目收尾。

outcomes.zh: 本组获评优秀课题组，本人获评优秀组长。
outcomes.en: The group was recognized as an outstanding team and the user as an outstanding lead.
outcomes.chinese-traditional: 本組獲評優秀課題組，本人獲評優秀組長。

outcomes.zh: 组内两名成员分别获评优秀课题员和专题之星。
outcomes.en: Two team members were recognized as Outstanding Project Member and Topic Star.
outcomes.chinese-traditional: 組內兩名成員分別獲評優秀課題員和專題之星。

alt.zh: 小问号 weekend 优秀组长证书
alt.chinese-traditional: 小問號 weekend 優秀組長證書

context.zh: 累计志愿服务 27 小时；秋季担任小问号 weekend 专题管理组科学课题组组长。
context.en: Recorded 27 volunteer hours and served as science-group lead in the autumn Question Mark Weekend program.
context.chinese-traditional: 累計志願服務 27 小時；秋季擔任小問號 weekend 專題管理組科學課題組組長。

reflection.zh: 即时沟通、头脑风暴、各司其职和积极跟进是团队合作的关键；课程设计还需站在青少年视角审视科学性与可接受性。
reflection.en: Timely communication, brainstorming, clear roles, and active follow-up are central to teamwork; lesson design must also be reviewed from young learners’ perspectives for scientific quality and accessibility.
reflection.chinese-traditional: 即時溝通、頭腦風暴、各司其職和積極跟進是團隊合作的關鍵；課程設計還需站在青少年視角審視科學性與可接受性。

title.zh: 太阳树洞：两期朋辈回信与心理关怀

title.chinese-traditional: 太陽樹洞：兩期朋輩回信與心理關懷

summary.zh: 完成两期太阳树洞朋辈回信服务，以倾听、问题回应和适度建议支持来信者。
summary.en: Completed two cycles of peer letter-response service focused on listening, problem response, and appropriate guidance.
summary.chinese-traditional: 完成兩期太陽樹洞朋輩回信服務，以傾聽、問題回應和適度建議支持來信者。

actions.zh: 2024 年完成 10 月编号 15、11 月编号 24 两封回信。
actions.en: Completed two 2024 replies: October No. 15 and November No. 24.
actions.chinese-traditional: 2024 年完成 10 月編號 15、11 月編號 24 兩封回信。

actions.zh: 2025 年完成 2 月编号 15、3 月编号 21、5 月编号 23 三封回信。
actions.en: Completed three 2025 replies: February No. 15, March No. 21, and May No. 23.
actions.chinese-traditional: 2025 年完成 2 月編號 15、3 月編號 21、5 月編號 23 三封回信。

actions.zh: 2026 年完成 3 月编号 27、4 月编号 35、5 月编号 34、6 月编号 4 四封回信。
actions.en: Completed four 2026 replies: March No. 27, April No. 35, May No. 34, and June No. 4.
actions.chinese-traditional: 2026 年完成 3 月編號 27、4 月編號 35、5 月編號 34、6 月編號 4 四封回信。

outcomes.zh: 两个周期均获评优秀回信志愿者。
outcomes.en: Recognized as an outstanding reply volunteer in both cycles.
outcomes.chinese-traditional: 兩個週期均獲評優秀回信志願者。

alt.zh: 太阳树洞优秀志愿者证书
alt.chinese-traditional: 太陽樹洞優秀志願者證書

alt.zh: 2025—2026 年度太阳树洞 Pro 优秀回信志愿者证书
alt.chinese-traditional: 2025—2026 年度太陽樹洞 Pro 優秀回信志願者證書
alt.en: 2025–2026 Outstanding Sun Tree Hole Pro reply volunteer certificate

context.zh: 2024—2025 周期累计 20 小时，服务目标是倾听、回应、鼓励、安慰，并针对问题提供可参考的解决思路。
context.en: The 2024–2025 cycle recorded 20 hours, aiming to listen, respond, encourage, comfort, and offer possible approaches to problems.
context.chinese-traditional: 2024—2025 週期累計 20 小時，服務目標是傾聽、回應、鼓勵、安慰，並針對問題提供可參考的解決思路。

context.zh: 2026 周期累计 16 小时，更强调问题导向、想象空间、共情能力和简洁文字表达。
context.en: The 2026 cycle recorded 16 hours and emphasized problem orientation, imagination, empathy, and concise writing.
context.chinese-traditional: 2026 週期累計 16 小時，更強調問題導向、想像空間、共情能力和簡潔文字表達。

reflection.zh: “树洞是有回音的”：回信既回应来信者内心，也通过具体书信传递朴素的人文关怀。
reflection.en: “A tree hole has an echo”: the replies respond to inner concerns while conveying humane care through concrete letters.
reflection.chinese-traditional: “樹洞是有迴音的”：回信既回應來信者內心，也通過具體書信傳遞樸素的人文關懷。

reflection.zh: 第二期来信更简洁甚至没有明确问题，需要从“为何仍选择来信”出发，做真诚的倾听者与朋辈心理关怀者。
reflection.en: The second cycle often contained brief letters without explicit questions, requiring sincere listening and peer care grounded in why the writer still chose to reach out.
reflection.chinese-traditional: 第二期來信更簡潔甚至沒有明確問題，需要從“為何仍選擇來信”出發，做真誠的傾聽者與朋輩心理關懷者。

title.zh: 森林信使：三封长期陪伴回信
title.en: Forest Messenger: Three Letters of Long-Term Companionship
title.chinese-traditional: 森林信使：三封長期陪伴回信

summary.zh: 以一对一书信交流支持小学生表达、自信与成长，在持续与边界感之间完成三次互动。
summary.en: Supported a primary-school student's expression and confidence through three one-to-one letter exchanges.
summary.chinese-traditional: 以一對一書信交流支持小學生表達、自信與成長，在持續與邊界感之間完成三次互動。

actions.zh: 围绕“人生关键词”“时间变慢”“假期计划”完成三次书信互动。
actions.en: Completed three exchanges around life keywords, time slowing down, and holiday plans.
actions.chinese-traditional: 圍繞“人生關鍵詞”“時間變慢”“假期計劃”完成三次書信互動。

actions.zh: 每次均在次日完成回信与打卡。
actions.en: Completed each reply and check-in the following day.
actions.chinese-traditional: 每次均在次日完成回信與打卡。

actions.zh: 使用适合小学生认知的语言，将日常分享与启发思考结合。
actions.en: Used age-appropriate language combining daily sharing with reflective prompts.
actions.chinese-traditional: 使用適合小學生認知的語言，將日常分享與啟發思考結合。

actions.zh: 通过提问拓展话题，并加入笔、明信片和手绘插图，使内容具体有趣。
actions.en: Expanded topics through questions and added a pen, postcards, and hand-drawn illustrations to make the exchange concrete and engaging.
actions.chinese-traditional: 通過提問拓展話題，並加入筆、明信片和手繪插圖，使內容具體有趣。

actions.zh: 保持积极情绪、适当边界感和持续责任。
actions.en: Maintained positive tone, appropriate boundaries, and sustained responsibility.
actions.chinese-traditional: 保持積極情緒、適當邊界感和持續責任。

outcomes.zh: 获评 2025 森林信使优秀志愿者。
outcomes.en: Recognized as a 2025 Outstanding Forest Messenger Volunteer.
outcomes.chinese-traditional: 獲評 2025 森林信使優秀志願者。
